tests.name: Missing values handled
tests.description: Checks that missing cells are either absent or handled by the pipeline.
tests.details: 1.8% of cells are missing and are filled by imputation.

tests.name: Duplicate rows
tests.description: Duplicates inflate test scores because identical rows leak between train and test.
tests.details: No duplicate rows.

tests.name: Target distribution (skew)
tests.description: A heavily skewed target (like prices) lets a few expensive rows dominate the error.
tests.details: Skewness of 'price_lakhs' is +0.99.

tests.name: Constant features
tests.description: Features with a single value carry no information and add noise.
tests.details: All features vary.

tests.name: Outlier exposure
tests.description: Extreme values can dominate distance- and gradient-based models.
tests.details: 0.1% of numeric values are extreme outliers (|z| > 4).

tests.name: Target leakage
tests.description: A feature that is almost perfectly correlated with the target usually leaks the label.
tests.details: No feature is suspiciously correlated with the target.

tests.name: Sufficient sample size
tests.description: Too few rows per feature leads to unstable, overfitted models.
tests.details: 1600 usable rows for 8 features (200.0 rows per feature).

tests.name: Hold-out R² (accuracy)
tests.description: Share of variance explained on unseen data - the regression equivalent of accuracy.
tests.details: R² 0.858, RMSE 19.02, MAE 14.00 on 400 unseen rows.

tests.name: Mean absolute % error
tests.description: Average relative error of the predictions.
tests.details: Predictions are off by 11.4% on average.

tests.name: 5-fold cross-validation
tests.description: Validation score: k-fold cross-validation inside the training data (the test set is never used).

tests.name: Cross-validation stability
tests.description: Large variance between folds means the model is unstable.
tests.details: Standard deviation across folds is 0.014.

tests.name: Overfitting gap
tests.description: Compares training and test R²; a large gap means memorisation.
tests.details: Train R² 0.906 vs test R² 0.858.

tests.name: Valid predictions (non-negative)
tests.description: Predictions must be finite and positive (a price can never be negative).
tests.details: All predictions are valid and positive.

tests.name: Gaussian noise robustness
tests.description: Adds noise (10% of each feature's std) to test inputs and measures the R² drop.
tests.details: R² changes by -0.004 under noise.

tests.name: Missing values at inference
tests.description: Production data is rarely complete - the model must not crash or collapse.
tests.details: With 10% of numeric cells blanked, R² changes by -0.040.

tests.name: Unit-change invariance (metamorphic)
tests.description: Changing units of a feature (e.g. metres → millimetres) must not change predictions.
tests.details: 99.2% of predictions stay within 2% after rescaling features and retraining.

tests.name: Training-order invariance (metamorphic)
tests.description: Shuffling the order of training rows must not change what the model learns.
tests.details: 100.0% of predictions stay within 5% after shuffling training data.

tests.name: Edge-case inputs (generated)
tests.description: Auto-generates min/max, zero, out-of-distribution, null, unseen-category and special-character inputs.
tests.details: 190 edge cases generated, 0 crashed or produced invalid output.

tests.name: Adversarial perturbation (worst-case search)
tests.description: Searches 8 adversarial perturbations of ±10% std per row for prediction flips.
tests.details: 99.6% of rows stay within 20% under every adversarial perturbation.

tests.name: Reproducibility
tests.description: Training twice with the same seed must give identical predictions.
tests.details: Two independent trainings produced identical predictions.

tests.name: Train/test drift (PSI)
tests.description: Population Stability Index flags features whose distribution shifted between train and test.
tests.details: Largest shift is 'distance_to_city_km' with PSI 0.029.

tests.name: Prediction latency
tests.description: Time needed to score 1,000 rows.
tests.details: 5 ms per 1,000 predictions (training took 0.11s).

tests.name: Data-slice performance
tests.description: Compares accuracy (or % error) across slices such as gender, age and region.
tests.details: Largest extra % error is 1.3 points on 'region'.

tests.name: Fairness: demographic parity difference
tests.description: Difference in predicted-outcome rate between groups of a protected attribute must stay below 10%. Demographic parity is one criterion and does not by itself prove a model is fair.
tests.details: Largest parity difference is 4.4% on protected attribute 'region'. (group bias for regression: |mean prediction − mean actual| per group.)
